Active good inertia gives trivial correction; bad inertia retains H1(I,V) rather than a false invariant replacement.

Separated length calculation pays inactive-good Euler determinants through E1 and finitely many bad/dyadic factors through F_E. Local duality, finite torsion and derived control exclude central zero of F_E. Constants remain independent of active prime count.

Finite-Artin cochain freeness, nilpotent perturbation and lifted minimal-model comparisons produce compatible models; acyclic termwise-surjective cones support inverse-limit compatibility.
